en: Sepia photo postcard showing a large baroque-style church facade with a small belfry and cross, attached to a multi‑windowed hospital building on a town square. A handwritten X marks one window. The printed caption reads "LÜGDE" at left and "Krankenhaus" at right. Reverse has German handwriting, a green Deutsches Reich 6‑pfennig stamp and a cancellation, and the printer's line for Lügde. Also printed is "Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont."
